name: @cotal-ai/zellij
description: Cotal Zellij integration: runtime provider for spawning agents in Zellij panes.

scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsx package.smoke.ts && node --input-type=module -e "await import('./dist/index.js'); console.log('zellij dist smoke: import passed')"
scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && pnpm run bundle
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/index.js --external:@cotal-ai/core --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cotalCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __cotalCreateRequire(import.meta.url);"
